name: GetCustomObject
label: Get a custom object
description: Retrieves a single custom object from Salesforce by its ID.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: The credential to connect with (JSON containing InstanceUrl, AccessToken, ApiVersion).

fields.name: CustomObjectNameOrId
fields.label: Custom Object API Name
fields.description: The API name of the custom object (e.g., 'Invoice__c').

fields.name: RecordId
fields.label: Record ID
fields.description: The ID of the custom object record to retrieve.

fields.name: Fields
fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Optional comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'Name,Status__c,Amount__c'). If empty, retrieves all available fields.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Salesforce.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The retrieved custom object data as a dictionary.
